verses.sanskrit:
सौतिरुवाच।
              इत्युक्तो गरुडः सर्पैस्ततो मातरमब्रवीत्। गच्छाम्यमृतमाहर्तुं भक्ष्यमिच्छामि वेदितुम्॥१॥
verses.english: Sauti said : Thus told by the snakes, Garuda said to his mother, “I shall go to bring the Ambrosia, but I wish to eat something. Tell me where to get it.”

verses.sanskrit: विनतोवाच। समुद्रकुक्षावेकान्ते निषादालयमुत्तमम्। निषादानां सहस्राणि तान्भुक्त्वाऽमृतमानय॥२॥
verses.english: Vinata said: The Nishadas have their homes in a remote place in the midst of the ocean. Eat thousands of Nishadas and bring the Ambrosia.

verses.sanskrit: न च ते ब्राह्मणं हन्तुं कार्या बुद्धिः कथंचन। अवध्यः सर्वभूतानां ब्राह्मणो ह्यनलोपमः॥३॥
verses.english: But let not your heart be ever set on killing a Brahmana. A Brahmana is not to be killed amongst all creatures; he is like the fire.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरर्को विषं शस्त्रं विप्रो भवति कोपितः। गुरुर्हि सर्वभूतानां ब्राह्मणः परिकीर्तितः॥४॥
verses.english: A Brahmana, when angry; becomes like the fire or the sun or the poison or a sharp weapon. A Brahmana is declared to be the preceptor of all creature. For these and other reasons the Brahmana is adored by all.

verses.sanskrit: एवमादिस्वरूपैस्तु सतां वै ब्राह्मणो मतः। स ते तात न हन्तव्यः संक्रुद्धेनापि सर्वथा॥५॥
verses.english: O child, he is never to be killed by you even if you be angry. Enmity with Brahmanas is never proper under any circumstances.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणानामभिद्रोहो न कर्तव्यः कथंचन। न ह्येवमग्निर्नादित्यो भस्म कुर्यात्तथाऽनघ॥६॥
यथा कुर्यादभिक्रुद्धो ब्राह्मणः संशितव्रतः। तदेतैर्विविधैर्लिङ्गैस्त्वं विद्यास्तं द्विजोत्तमम्॥७॥
verses.english: O sinless one, neither fire nor the sun does consume so much as does a Brahman of rigid austerity when angry.

verses.sanskrit:
भूतानामग्रभूर्विप्रो वर्णश्रेष्ठः पिता गुरुः।
              गरुड उवाच।
              किंरूपो ब्राह्मणो मातः किंशीलः किंपराक्रमः॥८॥
verses.english: You must know a good Brahmana by these indications. A Brahmana is the first-born of all creatures, the best of four castes, the father, master and teacher of all.

verses.sanskrit: किंस्विदग्निनिभो भाति किंस्वित्सौम्यप्रदर्शनः। यथाहमभिजानीयां ब्राह्मणं लक्षणैः शुभैः॥९॥
verses.english: Garuda said: O mother, what form a Brahmana has? What is his character and what is his power? Does he shine like fire or is he of gentle nature?

verses.sanskrit: तन्मे कारणतो मातः पृच्छतो वक्तुमर्हसि। विनतोवाच। यस्ते कण्ठमनुप्राप्तो निगीर्णं बडिशं यथा॥१०॥
verses.english: O mother, you should tell me, who ask you, the auspicious indications by which I shall be able to recognise a Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: दहेदङ्गारवत्पुत्रं तं विद्याद्ब्राह्मणर्षभम्। विप्रस्त्वया न हन्तव्यः संक्रुद्धेनापि सर्वदा॥११॥
verses.english: Vinata said: O son, know him to be a Brahmana who will torture you like a fishhook, or burn you like a hot charcoal, when he will enter into your throat.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोवाच चैन विनता पुत्रहार्दादिदं वचः। जठरे न च जीर्येद्यस्तं जानीहि द्विजोत्तमम्॥१२॥
verses.english: “Know him to be a good Brahmana, who will not be digested in your stomach.” Vinata again repeated those words from the great love she bore for her son.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः प्रोवाच विनता पुत्रहार्दादिदं वचः। जानन्त्यप्यतुलं वीर्यमाशीर्वादपरायणा॥१३॥
प्रीता परमदुःखार्ता नागैर्विप्रकृता सती। विनतोवाच। पक्षौ ते मारुतः पातु चन्द्रसूर्यौ च पृष्ठतः॥१४॥
verses.english: Sauti said: Though she knew the matchless strength of her son, yet being exceedingly sorrowful and gentle and deceived by the Nagas, Vinata heartily blessed him, (saying)

verses.sanskrit: शिरश्च पातु वह्निस्ते वसवः सर्वतस्तनुम्। अहं च ते सदा पुत्र शान्तिस्वस्तिपरायणा॥१५॥
verses.english: Vinata said : Let Maruta protect your wings, let Chandra and Surya protect your back; let Agni protect your head and the Vasus your whole body.

verses.sanskrit: इहासीना भविष्यामि स्वस्तिकारे रता सदा। अरिष्टं व्रज पन्थानं पुत्र कार्यार्थसिद्धये॥१६॥
verses.english: I also, my son, shall somewhere, wishing for your good and being engaged in ceremonies that will produce you good. Go then, my son, in safety to accomplish your purpose.

verses.sanskrit:
सौतिरुवाच।
              ततः स मातुर्वचनं निशम्य वितत्य पक्षौ नभ उत्पपात। ततो निषादान्बलवानुपागतो बुभुक्षितः काल इवान्तकोऽपरः॥१७॥
verses.english: Sauti said: Having heard what his mother said, Garuda stretched his wings and rose to the skies and then being endued with great strength like another Yama, he soon came upon the Nishadas.
verses.bhavadeepa: इहासतीति पाठे आसीना । चक्षिङो ङित्करणाज्ज्ञापकादनुदात्तेत्त्वलक्षणस्यात्मनेपदस्यानित्यत्वादसेः शतृप्रत्ययः । स्वस्तिकारे कल्याणकरणे । अनिष्टं निर्विघ्नं यथा स्यात्तथा ॥१६॥

verses.sanskrit: स तान्निषादानुपसंहरंस्तदा रजः समुद्भूय नभःस्पृशं महत्। समुद्रकुक्षौ च विशोषयन्पयः समीपजान्भूधरजान्विचालयन्॥१८॥
verses.english: Bent upon destroying the Nishadas he raised up a great storm of dust that covered the whole sky. He sucked up water from the ocean and shook the trees growing on adjacent mountains.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स चक्रे महदाननं तदा निषादमार्गं प्रतिरुध्य पक्षिराट्। ततो निषादास्त्वरिताः प्रवव्रजुर्यतो मुखं तस्य भुजंगभोजिनः॥१९॥
verses.english: Then the king of birds, opening his great mouth, stopped the road of the Nishadas and the Nishadas too went into his open mouth flying in fright.

verses.sanskrit: तदाननं विवृतमतिप्रमाणवत्समभ्ययुर्गगनमिवार्दिताः खगाः। सहस्रशः पवनजोविमोहिता यथाऽनिलप्रचलितपादपे वने॥२०॥
verses.english: As birds in great affliction rose by thousands into the skies when the trees of the forest were shaken in a great storm, so the Nishadas, blinded by the dust raised by the storm, entered into the wide-opened mouth of the great snake-eater.

verses.sanskrit: ततः खगो वदनममित्रतापनः समाहरत्परिचपलो महाबलाः। निषूदयन्बहुविधमत्स्यजीविनो बभुक्षितो गगनचरेश्वरस्तदा॥२१॥
verses.english: Then the hungry bird, the chastiser of his enemies, who is endued with great strength and who moves with the greatest speed to achieve his end, closed his mouth, thereby killing thousands of Nishadas who followed the occupation of fishermen.
